name: Teferi
description: Teferi is a centuries-old time-magic mage and planeswalker of Zhalfir, known for saving his homeland by phasing it out of time and as a member of the Gatewatch.

timeline.summary: At the moment of the blast Urza meets Teferi beyond time, his body is remade with the Mightstone and Weakstone as eyes, and his spark ignites.
timeline.quote: igniting his latent planeswalker spark

citation.text: "Urza", section "Brothers' War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi Akosa phases out Aku and Zhalfir during the Phyrexian Invasion.
timeline.quote: Aku and all its surroundings were phased out along with the rest of Zhalfir by the temporal planeswalker Teferi Akosa .

citation.text: "Shauku", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Embereck dies fighting Ravidel and Leshrac flees; Taysir then confronts Ravidel, who nearly defeats his mentor until Teferi intervenes.
timeline.quote: Embereck perished in the battle, and Leshrac fled.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ravidel's summoning backfires, a sinkhole forms under Hamath, and he plunges into the abyss while Dakkon routs his forces; he is assumed dead.
timeline.quote: Ravidel was not heard from again and was assumed to be dead.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Taysir reconciles with Sandruu, and Teferi and Eskil free Daria from the Amber Prison.
timeline.quote: Teferi retrieved Daria's Amber Prison, and with Eskil’s help, freed her at last.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi refuses Leshrac's recruitment and sends Caliphear to warn Freyalise.
timeline.quote: Leshrac then steals some artifacts and spells from the island, ensuring that his visit is not a waste of time.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War (comic)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Embereck is destroyed and Leshrac flees; Taysir confronts Ravidel and is saved by Teferi.
timeline.quote: The weakened Embereck is destroyed, and Leshrac is forced to flee.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War (comic)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi's Force of Nature trap and the Chime's chaos make the earth collapse and swallow Ravidel.
timeline.quote: The earth around Ravidel collapses, and he falls.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War (comic)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi retrieves the Amber Prison and Eskil releases Daria.
timeline.quote: Teferi retrieves the Amber Prison from the Null Moon and Eskil releases Daria from it.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War (comic)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi unified the houses into guilds to serve Zhalfir.
timeline.quote: An ancient court mage unified the houses into guilds to serve Zhalfir above their own interests.

citation.text: Tranquil Domain (Mirage, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Kaervek sails to the Chaza Isles to investigate an energy surge and meets Mangara and Jolrael.
timeline.quote: He did meet with two other people who had been attracted by the energy surge

citation.text: "Kaervek", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaervek wages a long war with his allies, then attacks Teferi's isle; Jolrael ambushes him and Teferi sinks his fleet.
timeline.quote: After Teferi sank his fleet, Kaervek managed to escape to the Uuserk Marshes.

citation.text: "Kaervek", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi's Isle returns and Teferi reawakens.
timeline.quote: The ancient mage Teferi himself reawakened

citation.text: "Mangara's Harmony", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi's phasing energy burst makes every plant, animal and building on his isle phase out of existence.
timeline.quote: The energy unleashed caused every plant, animal, and building on the island to phase out of existence, leaving just bare rock behind.

citation.text: "Mirage War", section "Ancient History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi phases out Zhalfir entirely, opening the Zhalfir rift.
timeline.quote: In an instant, Zhalfir and all its people, animals, plants, buildings, and even the landmass itself, were phased out.

citation.text: "Rift", section "Zhalfirin rift". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Zhalfir rift is sealed, forever losing Zhalfir from Dominaria.
timeline.quote: sealing the rift closed the nation off from being able to return

citation.text: "Rift", section "Zhalfirin rift". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Phyrexians attack Tolaria and Karn travels back in time to stop them, causing the Tolarian Temporal Disaster; Teferi is trapped in a slow-time bubble for thirty years.
timeline.quote: Teferi survived but was caught in a slow-time bubble for thirty years

citation.text: "Teferi Akosa", section "Early years". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jhoira builds a portal machine and Karn and Urza pull Teferi out of the bubble.
timeline.quote: the resilient bodies of Karn and Urza could pass through and pull Teferi out

citation.text: "Teferi Akosa", section "Early years". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi's experiment with time magic ignites his spark and he becomes a planeswalker.
timeline.quote: A Spark ignited . Teferi had become a Planeswalker.

citation.text: "Teferi Akosa", section "The Mirage War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi crowns Queen Yormeba and, tired of squabbles, sails with advisors to the Chaza Isles.
timeline.quote: Teferi crowned her as Queen Yormeba

citation.text: "Teferi Akosa", section "The Mirage War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi's attempt to repair the time stream phases everything but bare rock off Teferi's Isle.
timeline.quote: The Phasing of Teferi's Isle caused everything but the bare rock of the island to instantly phase out of existence.

citation.text: "Teferi Akosa", section "The Mirage War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Two hundred years later the isle returns and Teferi learns his cure indirectly caused a great war.
timeline.quote: After two hundred years, Teferi's Isle returned.

citation.text: "Teferi Akosa", section "The Mirage War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi sinks Kaervek's armada and sends a drake to rescue Jolrael.
timeline.quote: Teferi finally intervened, sinking Kaervek's armada and sending a drake to rescue Jolrael.

citation.text: "Teferi Akosa", section "The Mirage War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi predicts Kaervek's coming demise.
timeline.quote: in truth, they mourn aloud for his impending demise."

citation.text: Shrieking Drake (Visions, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Teferi's isle returns and he slays one of Jolrael's dragons.
timeline.quote: Teferi slew the dragon and immediately set out to discover what was happening

citation.text: "Mirage War", section "War in Jamuraa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jolrael seeks Teferi's help, but he refuses to intercede and offers dreams and visions instead.
timeline.quote: Instead, he offered to guide the leaders of Jamuraa through dreams and visions.

citation.text: "Mirage War", section "War in Jamuraa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaervek sails to Teferi's Isle, where Teferi destroys his armada and Jolrael turns on him.
timeline.quote: During the battle, Jolrael turned upon Kaervek, severely injuring the mage in a heated arcane battle.

citation.text: "Mirage War", section "Shocking Visions". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ertai questions what Teferi thought he was doing.
timeline.quote: "I don't like to speak ill of 'walkers . . . but just what did Teferi think he was doing?"

citation.text: Teferi's Veil (Weatherlight, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sisay's crew joins Asmira and Rashida Scalebane to free Mangara.
timeline.quote: Together, they freed Mangara

citation.text: "Sisay", section "Early Years". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi remarks on controlling time.
timeline.quote: "Controlling time ensures you need never look impulsive again."

citation.text: Impulse (World Championship Decks 1997, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Barrin's progress report calls Teferi a problem student.
timeline.quote: Teferi is a problem student.

citation.text: Disruptive Student (Urza's Saga, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Teferi creates Teferi's Drakes at the Tolarian Academy, and Barrin uses them to defend the university against Kerrick's forces.
timeline.quote: they were used by Barrin in the defense of the University against Kerrick 's forces.

citation.text: "Drake", section "Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi phases Zhalfir out of the time stream, taking most of Dominaria's griffins with it.
timeline.quote: When Zhalfir was phased out of the time stream by the Planeswalker Teferi

citation.text: "Griffin", section "Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kerrick uses Jhoira to infiltrate the Academy, causing the disaster that strands her on Tolaria for ten years; she saves Teferi.
timeline.quote: She was used by Kerrick to infiltrate the Academy.

citation.text: "Jhoira", section "Academy years". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karn finds Jhoira's corpse and slays her killer, a negator; Urza tells him Barrin and Teferi are dead too and sends him back in time.
timeline.quote: Karn then fought and slew Jhoira's killer, a Phyrexian negator.

citation.text: "K'rrik", section "Saboteur". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jhoira takes Karn from Teferi's harassment and names him Karn, a Thran word for mighty.
timeline.quote: She granted him the name Karn, a Thran word for "mighty" or "strength".

citation.text: "Karn", section "Tolarian Academy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karn returns with Urza and Barrin to rebuild Tolaria and finds Jhoira alive and Teferi trapped in a slow-time bubble.
timeline.quote: discovered Jhoira still alive, and Teferi trapped in a slow-time bubble

citation.text: "Karn", section "Tolarian Academy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza gives a silver golem Xantcha's heart; named Karn, it learns emotions and befriends Jhoira while Teferi harasses it.
timeline.quote: taking the name Karn from the Thran word for mighty

citation.text: "Time Streams", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jhoira hides the shipwrecked Kerrick; Karn sees him steal powerstones and call for Negators, who massacre the students and teachers including Jhoira, Teferi and Barrin.
timeline.quote: The Phyrexian Negators massacred most of the students and teachers including Jhoira, Teferi, and Barrin.

citation.text: "Time Streams", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza's dirigible attack on the chasm fails and Jhoira falls into a coma; she later builds a machine to funnel fast time into slow-time areas, saving Teferi.
timeline.quote: Jhoira falls into a coma for several years

citation.text: "Time Streams", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza travels to Shiv, makes peace among the Viashino, goblins and dragons and puts them to work on the Thran Mana Rig.
timeline.quote: He makes peace between the local Viashino , Goblins , and fire dragons

citation.text: "Time Streams", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Months later Jhoira commands the Weatherlight, Teferi works to end Zhalfir's civil war, and Barrin reflects that Urza is finally sane.
timeline.quote: Barrin reflects that Urza is now finally sane.

citation.text: "Time Streams", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza, Barrin and Karn return with new students and find Jhoira alive and Teferi trapped in a slow-time bubble.
timeline.quote: discovered Jhoira still alive, and Teferi trapped in a slow-time bubble.

citation.text: "Tolaria", section "Invasion of Tolaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Invasion of Tolaria begins while Urza is away, and is ended by Barrin, Jhoira, Teferi and their allies.
timeline.quote: This invasion was ended only through the combined efforts of Barrin and his students, faculty, and artifact creatures

citation.text: "Tolaria", section "Invasion of Tolaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ten years later Urza, Barrin and Karn return, find Jhoira alive and Teferi trapped, and rescue him.
timeline.quote: discovered Jhoira still alive, and Teferi trapped in a slow-time bubble

citation.text: "Tolarian Academy", section "The Invasion of Tolaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Invasion of Tolaria is ended by Barrin, students, Jhoira, Teferi and Shiv allies.
timeline.quote: the Invasion of Tolaria began, with K'rrik 's negators swarming over the island

citation.text: "Tolarian Academy", section "The Invasion of Tolaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza founds the Tolarian Academy as Master Malzra, gathering talented scholars including Barrin, Teferi and Rayne.
timeline.quote: Under the pseudonym "Master Malzra," Urza summoned the most talented artificers

citation.text: "Urza", section "Tolaria and the Time Streams". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Tolarian Temporal Disaster destroys most of the Academy and kills hundreds after Karn is sent back to prevent a Phyrexian invasion.
timeline.quote: The Tolarian Temporal Disaster destroyed the majority of the Tolarian Academy, killing hundreds of inhabitants

citation.text: "Urza", section "Tolaria and the Time Streams". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The story departs from Gerrard and Volrath in a flashback showing the origins of the Legacy, meeting Teferi as a student and Serra at the peak of her power.
timeline.quote: Urza's Saga departs from the story of Gerrard and Volrath in a flashback, showing the origins of the Legacy

citation.text: "Urza's Saga", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the Phyrexian war, Teferi phases out Zhalfir to save it from further strife.
timeline.quote: the planeswalker Teferi decided to save thew region of Zhalfir from further strife, and phased it out

citation.text: "Jamuraa", section "Two Invasions". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi and Barrin defeat and destroy Latulla's banished followers in Jamuraa.
timeline.quote: were eventually defeated and destroyed by the planeswalker Teferi and Barrin the Master Wizard.

citation.text: "Keld", section "Prophecy War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi sends Barrin to reorganize the League, working with Mageta, Rayne and Jolrael.
timeline.quote: was dispatched by planeswalker Teferi to reorganize the League's forces

citation.text: "Prophecy War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Barrin dissolves Greel with a spark spell and then executes the crushed Latulla.
timeline.quote: Barrin used a cascading spark spell to dissolve Greel into minute parts, killing him.

citation.text: "Prophecy War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Embittered Barrin and shaken Teferi turn away from Urza's plan.
timeline.quote: began to withdraw from Urza’s coalition

citation.text: "Prophecy War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi and Urza agree the Phyrexian portal must be closed, although Teferi wanted no part of Urza's plans.
timeline.quote: both agreed the Phyrexian portal must be closed.

citation.text: Disrupt (Invasion, 2000), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Teferi tells Urza he has considered the problems of uprooting continents but the alternative is worse.
timeline.quote: "I have," replied Teferi, "but the alternative is worse."

citation.text: Tectonic Instability (Invasion, 2000), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Greel slays Rayne in the final battle of the Prophecy War, and Barrin in rage destroys the Keldon army, Greel and the overlord Latulla.
timeline.quote: Rayne was slain by Greel

citation.text: "Barrin", section "The Prophecy War in Jamuraa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi phases north-western Jamuraa and part of Shiv out of existence.
timeline.quote: so phased north-western Jamuraa and a large portion of Shiv out of existence

citation.text: "Dominaria (plane)", section "First Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi and Urza shut down Phyrexian portals above Zhalfir and Teferi phases out his homeland, angering Urza.
timeline.quote: Teferi uses the energy released this way to phase out his homeland.

citation.text: "Invasion (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi phases out Zhalfir entirely, leaving the Zhalfirin Void, denying Phyrexia its resources.
timeline.quote: Teferi used the residual energy to phase out Zhalfir entirely, leaving behind the Zhalfirin Void

citation.text: "Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria", section "First stage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi phases out most of Shiv, taking himself and Jhoira with it.
timeline.quote: Teferi phased out the majority of Shiv, taking both himself and Jhoira with it

citation.text: "Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria", section "First stage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi phases out part of Shiv, leaving a hole in Dominaria.
timeline.quote: leaving a hole in Dominaria.

citation.text: "Rift", section "Shivan rift". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi heals the Shivan rift, the first to close, sacrificing his spark.
timeline.quote: Teferi successfully healed the damage, sacrificing his spark in the process.

citation.text: "Rift", section "Shivan rift". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jhoira uses the Rig against the Phyrexians; Teferi phases a chunk of Shiv out with Jhoira and part of the Rig.
timeline.quote: Teferi phased out a large chunk of Shiv along with Jhoira and part of the Mana Rig

citation.text: "Shiv", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi phases out most of Suq'Ata's territories during the Phyrexian Invasion; they are lost forever after Jeska closes the rift.
timeline.quote: During the Phyrexian Invasion Teferi planeswalker phased out most of Suq'Ata's territorities.

citation.text: "Suq'Ata", section "Partially phased out". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: As the Phyrexian Invasion begins, Teferi overloads the portals and casts a gigantic phasing spell removing Northwestern Jamuraa (Zhalfir).
timeline.quote: Teferi weaved it into one gigantic phasing spell that removed Northwestern Jamuraa.

citation.text: "Teferi Akosa", section "Avoiding the invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi also phases out Shiv to save it from the Phyrexians over Urza's objections.
timeline.quote: Teferi removed the rest of Shiv from the time stream to save them

citation.text: "Teferi Akosa", section "Avoiding the invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi creates the Creeds of Magic, originally called Guilds, as his final act before departing Zhalfir.
timeline.quote: Teferi's final act before his departure was the creation of the Creeds of Magic, originally called Guilds.

citation.text: "Zhalfir (plane)", section "The Creeds of Magic". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi returns thirty years later to a continent near war, tutors Yormeba and crowns her queen, then leaves with advisors for the Chaza Isles.
timeline.quote: After crowning her as Queen Yormeba , she brought peace to the nation but failed to unify it.

citation.text: "Zhalfir (plane)", section "The Femeref secession". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi phases Zhalfir out of Dominaria to spare it from the Phyrexian assault.
timeline.quote: He phased out Zhalfir alongside parts of northwestern Jamuraa because he wanted to spare it from the horrors of the Phyrexian assault.

citation.text: "Zhalfir (plane)", section "Phased out". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi returns three hundred years later and closes the Shivan rift by sacrificing his planeswalker spark.
timeline.quote: He managed to close the Shivan rift by sacrificing his planeswalker spark.

citation.text: "Zhalfir (plane)", section "Phased out". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Wrenn explains to Teferi how he could unravel his spells and promises to help return Zhalfir.
timeline.quote: she explained how he could unravel his spells and promised to help him with returning Zhalfir

citation.text: "Zhalfir (plane)", section "Phased out". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi proposes and Jhoira declines.
timeline.quote: who asked for her hand in marriage, though she declined

timeline.summary: Kwende backs away and Subira drives Teferi off in her wagon.
timeline.quote: Kwende stared at her as the moment stretched, then he slowly stepped back.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 7" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Teferi agrees to travel with Subira's caravan for a while.
timeline.quote: For a while,

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 7" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Years later Subira settles down with Teferi and they raise Niambi.
timeline.quote: A few years ago, Subira had found someone else to run her caravan, and she had settled down with Teferi

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 7" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Teferi freezes Niambi mid-fall by instinct.
timeline.quote: Teferi cast the spell out of pure instinct and Niambi froze in mid-air.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 7" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Teferi reflects that he cannot trade freedom for safety, resolving to search for a way to return Zhalfir.
timeline.quote: Urza had certainly created powerful artifacts that might help.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 7" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Teferi releases the spell and catches Niambi.
timeline.quote: As time moved around her again, she landed in her father's arms and laughed with delight.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 7" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira gave Teferi a crystal pulsing with his planeswalker spark; he wonders whether it was a blessing or a curse.
timeline.quote: The crystal pulsed with the power of Teferi's planeswalker spark.

citation.text: Opt (Dominaria, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Teferi received a fire spell's pieces out of rhythm and meaningless.
timeline.quote: Its pieces reached Teferi out of rhythm, meaningless.

citation.text: Syncopate (Dominaria, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Teferi enchanted an army of statues to guard Zhalfir; his homeland is gone.
timeline.quote: Long ago, I enchanted an army of statues to guard Zhalfir.

citation.text: Teferi's Sentinel (Dominaria, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Jhoira tells Teferi the world is healing from its wounds and urges him to heal as well.
timeline.quote: Everywhere you look, this world is healing from its wounds.

citation.text: Meandering River (Dominaria, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight crew defeats the Cabal's stronghold and kills Belzenlok.
timeline.quote: managed to defeat the Cabal's Stronghold and kill Belzenlok

citation.text: "Gatewatch", section "Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi makes his Oath and joins the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: Then Teferi made his Oath and joined the Gatewatch.

citation.text: "Gatewatch", section "Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The crew learns of the Blackblade, planeswalkers reinforce them, and Jhoira returns Teferi's spark powerstone to him; they fight Yargle at the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: Jhoira finally found the right moment to hand over the powerstone containing Teferi's spark to its rightful owner

citation.text: "Jhoira", section "Fighting Belzenlok". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi weds Subira and they have a daughter, Niambi.
timeline.quote: They were wed soon after that and had many simple, happy years together.

citation.text: "Teferi Akosa", section "Family man". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jhoira returns Teferi's spark to him in a powerstone and he joins the Gatewatch against Bolas.
timeline.quote: After he became a Planeswalker again he joined the Gatewatch to fight Nicol Bolas .

citation.text: "Teferi Akosa", section "Restored". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi uses the Temporal Anchor in Urza's Tower to travel back to the Brothers' War to learn how to fire the Golgothian Sylex.
timeline.quote: to travel back in time to the Brothers' War .

citation.text: "Time stream", section "Teferi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi freezes Multani and the trees with time magic from the Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: "It's time magic."

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 9" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Teferi greets Karn aboard the Weatherlight, and Jhoira says Ajani told her of Venser's sacrifice.
timeline.quote: Ajani Goldmane came to tell me. Teferi knows, too.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 9" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira shows Teferi the Powerstone locket holding his spark and asks him to take it back, so he can help kill Bolas.
timeline.quote: "The Mana Rig." She held it out to him. "Will you take it back?"

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 9" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Teferi decides to take back his spark, and Jhoira drops the pendant into his palm.
timeline.quote: She pulled the pendant off her neck and dropped it into Teferi's waiting palm. "Welcome back."

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 9" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Teferi tells Jhoira he does not regret giving up his spark.
timeline.quote: I regret a lot of things. But not that.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 10" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Gideon and Teferi wave off the thallids as someone else's problem.
timeline.quote: That sounds like someone else's problem,

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 10" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 May 2018.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight crosses into Urborg at dusk, and Jhoira reports the defaced monument she calls the Fools' Tomb.
timeline.quote: Apparently the Cabal calls it the Fools' Tomb.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 11" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 May 2018.

timeline.summary: At dawn the party sees the Stronghold in the volcano's caldera, and Gideon, Chandra, Karn and Teferi set out on foot.
timeline.quote: Belzenlok has done some rebuilding,

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 11" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Teferi slows time around a grotto of spirits so the party can pass unseen.
timeline.quote: With a gesture Teferi slowed time around the spirits

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 11" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Teferi reveals he fought Bolas long ago and lost, and says he took his spark back to join the fight; Karn says he will consider the invitation.
timeline.quote: One of the reasons I took my spark back was to come with you.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 11" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Teferi casts a time-slowing spell around Gideon and Chandra, who walk through the Stronghold's frozen guards.
timeline.quote: Then he realized Teferi and Karn had seemed to freeze in place

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 11" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Teferi and Karn rejoin the ship as the Weatherlight attacks, and Teferi dissolves the first gate while Jhoira's owl blows up the next with a mana-burner.
timeline.quote: Teferi held out his hand and the gate across the causeway turned red with corrosion, then dissolved in a puff of rust.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Urgoros lands on the deck and fights the crew, and Liliana cannot control it or use the Chain Veil.
timeline.quote: Jhoira, I can't stop it!

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Gideon gives Teferi the Gatewatch oath, while Karn and Jaya agree to fight Bolas without taking the oath.
timeline.quote: Gideon was giving Teferi the Gatewatch oath while Chandra stood by.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: The planeswalkers leave Dominaria, but Liliana cannot planeswalk and Nicol Bolas appears to claim her.
timeline.quote: Nicol Bolas materialized out of the darkness, his huge scaled dragon form looming over her

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: On the new plane Jace tells the others that Liliana never intended to come and used them, but Gideon insists she has changed.
timeline.quote: She used you, just like she uses everyone.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Teferi muses to Jhoira about nature mages venerating the work of Urza's apprentice.
timeline.quote: "What would Urza think, I wonder, if he could hear how the nature mages still snarl at his name, but venerate the work of his apprentice?"

citation.text: Magus of the Candelabra (Battlebond, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Bolas saves Liliana from the assassination attempt by destroying the buildings under Jace's team.
timeline.quote: Bolas stepped in and saved Liliana by destroying the buildings they were standing on

citation.text: "Gatewatch", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace, Jaya, Teferi and Vivien volunteer to assassinate Liliana.
timeline.quote: Jace, Jaya, Teferi, and Vivien volunteered to assassinate Liliana.

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace, Jaya, Teferi and Vivien try to assassinate Liliana and nearly succeed until Bolas destroys the buildings and saves her; Teferi saves the others.
timeline.quote: Bolas stepped in and saved Liliana by destroying the buildings they were standing on

citation.text: "Jaya Ballard", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi slows time around the Planar Bridge and saves many lives during the War of the Spark.
timeline.quote: Teferi slowed down the time around the Planar Bridge

citation.text: "Teferi Akosa", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi's team nearly assassinates Liliana but Bolas saves her; Teferi slows their falls.
timeline.quote: Teferi saved himself and the other three Planeswalkers by slowing their falls.

citation.text: "Teferi Akosa", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vivien, Jace, Jaya and Teferi nearly assassinate Liliana, but Bolas saves her by destroying the buildings.
timeline.quote: Bolas stepped in and saved Liliana by destroying the buildings they were standing on.

citation.text: "Vivien Reid", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace, Lavinia, Gideon, Teferi, Chandra, Jaya, Ajani and Karn arrive and join the fight, and Gideon names the enemy the Eternals.
timeline.quote: Form up! The Eternals are still coming! We need to save as many people as possible!

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 May 2019.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch renews its Oaths, and Nissa speaks hers for the first time.
timeline.quote: Never again. Not on any world.

citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Guild forces and planeswalkers charge the Citadel as the Dreadhorde engages them.
timeline.quote: Those Planeswalkers not fallen—or not yet fallen—were side by side with guild warriors, engaging the silent Dreadhorde.

citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Kaya swears the Gatewatch Oath and is accepted.
timeline.quote: Never again. For the living and the dead, I will keep watch .

citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Cathars burst into an inn with reports of a white witch, and Teferi joins them as an excuse to leave.
timeline.quote: cathars from the local church came charging into the inn with reports of a white witch seen in the woods

citation.text: "Tangles" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Teferi, drifting away from the cathars, finds a pale woman speaking to an oak.
timeline.quote: paused when he saw the figure standing in the shadow of one of the great oaks

citation.text: "Tangles" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Hearing the cathars, Wrenn suspects Teferi lured her and summons fire.
timeline.quote: So you were a lure to call and catch me, then?

citation.text: "Tangles" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Teferi offers Wrenn his arm and they walk deeper into the forest to avoid the cathars.
timeline.quote: Then we walk.

citation.text: "Tangles" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Teferi senses an unseen presence following them.
timeline.quote: We're being followed,

citation.text: "Tangles" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Teferi's blue magic reveals a twisted humanoid, which he banishes in a burst of necrotic energy.
timeline.quote: finally vanished in a burst of terrible, necrotic energy

citation.text: "Tangles" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: The path behind them has become a tangle of identical branching paths crackling with time magic.
timeline.quote: The distinctive crackle of time magic hung over it all.

citation.text: "Tangles" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Wrenn laments that the tree that called her is gone.
timeline.quote: The tree that called me is gone.

citation.text: "Tangles" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: They exchange names, and Wrenn says she has heard of Teferi's legend.
timeline.quote: They call me Wrenn.

citation.text: "Tangles" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Wrenn says she will trust Teferi for now, admitting she will die without a tree.
timeline.quote: I will trust you for now.

citation.text: "Tangles" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: After hours of walking, Wrenn points out they are looping back toward where they began.
timeline.quote: We've made a big loop.

citation.text: "Tangles" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Wrenn lends her natural magic so Teferi can hold his tangled spell.
timeline.quote: She hummed, a single clear, carrying note, and the natural magic of the wood swirled around him

citation.text: "Tangles" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Teferi unmakes the tangled spell by following Wrenn's advice and restores the path.
timeline.quote: Bit by bit, he straightened and unbent the cogs, repairing the spell's original intent

citation.text: "Tangles" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Teferi confides that he lost the continent of Zhalfir through a similar spell.
timeline.quote: The entire continent, through a spell much like this one.

citation.text: "Tangles" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Wrenn tells Teferi that Seven is grateful because his bent time ripened the sapling.
timeline.quote: Seven says they are grateful for what you've done

citation.text: "Tangles" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Wrenn leaves with Seven to show it lands outside Innistrad.
timeline.quote: I have promised Seven lands outside of Innistrad, and I must keep my word.

citation.text: "Tangles" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Teferi, alone, returns to the village having gained a lesson and a new ally.
timeline.quote: For the first time since entering these woods, Teferi was alone.

citation.text: "Tangles" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn finds Jace absent from his house but is greeted by Teferi, who guesses she has not slept.
timeline.quote: "Take it you didn't just come here to keep me company, Arlinn," he says.

citation.work: Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn tells Teferi the nights on Innistrad are growing longer and something is coming, and Chandra leaps down the stairs to greet her.
timeline.quote: "The nights on Innistrad are getting longer, but that means no one's getting any rest."

citation.work: Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaya joins them with a joke about pencil on ink-only forms, and Arlinn laughs for the first time.
timeline.quote: "So, you're the one who used pencil on the ink-only forms?"

citation.work: Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaya, Teferi and Chandra agree to help and travel with Arlinn to Katilda's coven in the Kessig woods.
timeline.quote: They'll come. They'll help.

citation.work: Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn introduces her friends to Adeline and the assembled cathars, priests and Kessigers.
timeline.quote: "Adeline's fine.

citation.work: Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Katilda explains that the Moonsilver key must be brought to the center of the Celestus to be joined with the Sungold lock, and that its whereabouts are unknown.
timeline.quote: "You bring it to the center of the Celestus.

citation.work: Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: The party reaches the ruined Thraben cathedral and sees it overrun with the undead.
timeline.quote: The groans of the unhallowed dead answer Chandra before any of the others can.

citation.work: Episode 3: The Fall of the House of Betzold
citation.text: "Episode 3: The Fall of the House of Betzold" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Adeline and her cathars charge the horde while Teferi slows the undead and Chandra covers the rear with sheets of fire.
timeline.quote: Two great sheets of flame fly from her hands

citation.work: Episode 3: The Fall of the House of Betzold
citation.text: "Episode 3: The Fall of the House of Betzold" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Adeline breaks down the upstairs door and Kaya presents the ghost of Dennick Betzold.
timeline.quote: "Here's your man," she says.

citation.work: Episode 3: The Fall of the House of Betzold
citation.text: "Episode 3: The Fall of the House of Betzold" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Outside Markov manor Arlinn repairs a broken Avacynian symbol and begins a prayer, and her friends join in one by one.
timeline.quote: she rights the symbol and starts a prayer.

citation.work: Episode 3: The Fall of the House of Betzold
citation.text: "Episode 3: The Fall of the House of Betzold" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: The group crosses the broken bridge into Markov manor and makes its way toward the throne room.
timeline.quote: The bridge floats in pieces.

citation.work: Episode 3: The Fall of the House of Betzold
citation.text: "Episode 3: The Fall of the House of Betzold" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Sorin refuses to give up the key, saying he has sacrificed enough and his family may descend into eternal night.
timeline.quote: Sorin snaps the book shut. "No."

citation.work: Episode 3: The Fall of the House of Betzold
citation.text: "Episode 3: The Fall of the House of Betzold" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Teferi finds the Moonsilver Key in the hands of a headless statue of Avacyn, and Arlinn takes it.
timeline.quote: Arlinn takes the key.

citation.work: Episode 3: The Fall of the House of Betzold
citation.text: "Episode 3: The Fall of the House of Betzold" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn sends Kaya off with the Moonsilver Key to deliver it to Katilda, and Chandra and Adeline ride to the front.
timeline.quote: "Kaya, take the key. Make sure it gets to Katilda."

citation.text: "Episode 4: Harvesttide" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Teferi plants his staff and slows time to hold back the sunset, calling on the witches to start the ritual.
timeline.quote: "Witches of the Dawnheart Coven!" he bellows, "Let's get this ritual started!"

citation.text: "Episode 4: Harvesttide" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Adeline commands the cathars in shield walls while Teferi's time magic stutters a dire's hammer.
timeline.quote: Clusters of cathars stand back to back with spears and shields

citation.text: "Episode 4: Harvesttide" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Teferi freezes the sun and the werewolves in the middle of a fight.
timeline.quote: Suddenly the sun paused in the sky and the werewolves' snarls froze on their faces.

citation.text: Borrowed Time (Innistrad: Midnight Hunt, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Chandra, Teferi and Arlinn search for the Moonsilver Key while Kaya clears spirits.
timeline.quote: Chandra, Teferi, and Arlinn sought clues to the Moonsilver Key's whereabouts while Kaya dispatched the spirits obstructing their path.

citation.text: Thraben Exorcism (Innistrad: Midnight Hunt, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sigarda and Sorin battle while Arlinn and Teferi recover the key from the Markov catacombs.
timeline.quote: As Sigarda and Sorin battled, Arlinn and Teferi recovered the key from the Markov catacombs.

citation.text: Secrets of the Key (Innistrad: Midnight Hunt, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The group finds Thraben destroyed and full of zombies, and Kaya scouts alone and finds a clue about the Key.
timeline.quote: They find the city destroyed and full of zombies

citation.text: "Adeline", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tovolar attacks the Harvesttide festival; Teferi delays the sunset and cathars led by Adeline fight the werewolves.
timeline.quote: Tovolar began his attack on the Harvesttide festival

citation.text: "Adeline", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Arlinn asks the Gatewatch for help finding the Moonsilver Key; Teferi, Kaya and Chandra agree.
timeline.quote: The three planeswalkers agree to help Arlinn and head to Innistrad.

citation.text: "Arlinn Kord", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tovolar's army attacks the Harvesttide festival and the planeswalkers, cathars and witches fight the werewolves.
timeline.quote: Cathars, witches and planeswalkers fought the werewolves to protect the humans .

citation.text: "Arlinn Kord", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tovolar's howlpack attacks the festival; the Gatewatch helps and Teferi slows the sunset.
timeline.quote: Teferi slowed the sunset

citation.text: "Dawnhart Coven", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi slows the sunset while Adeline and Chandra organize defense and Kaya delivers the Moonsilver Key to Katilda.
timeline.quote: Knowing that they would be overpowered when it became night, Teferi slowed the sunset.

citation.text: "Harvesttide Festival", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaya, Teferi and Chandra agree to help Arlinn find the Moonsilver Key.
timeline.quote: The three planeswalkers agree to help Arlin and head to Innistrad

citation.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Katilda recruits Arlinn and the Gatewatch to find the Moonsilver Key; they begin in Thraben.
timeline.quote: Katilda recruited Arlinn Kord and the Gatewatch to find the Moonsilver Key.

citation.text: "Moonsilver Key", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sorin refuses to hand over the Key and attacks Arlinn; Sigarda appears and stops him, and the group finds the Key in his quarters.
timeline.quote: In the second attack Sigarda appears

citation.text: "Moonsilver Key", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Katilda lets Teferi borrow the Key, which becomes a component of Saheeli's Temporal Anchor.
timeline.quote: Katilda allowed Teferi to borrow the key for his temporal studies

citation.text: "Moonsilver Key", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi meets Wrenn on Innistrad and they are trapped in a time loop he later undoes.
timeline.quote: trapping him and Wrenn in a loop of time

citation.text: "Teferi Akosa", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi's group retrieves the Moonsilver Key from Markov Manor with Sigarda's help but Olivia Voldaren steals it and the Eternal Night begins.
timeline.quote: Thus, the Eternal Night began.

citation.text: "Teferi Akosa", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi casts a spell to delay the sunset and stall the werewolves' transformation while planeswalkers, witches and cathars defend the humans.
